name: @treaty/cli
description: The standalone Treaty CLI (bin: treaty). Drives Treaty projects that have NO angular.json — a convention-based, federation-ready compiler driver. `treaty dev` starts the Vite or Rspack dev server with the Treaty plugin and automatic Module Federation; `treaty build` produces a deployable production build; `treaty generate` scaffolds standalone, federation-ready apps/libs/components. Treaty is a compiler, not a host: the CLI emits/builds and the developer runs the output, configuring nothing.
author: Jordan Hall
